name: The Memory Reef
introDiscord:
Moonlit coral grows here.

So does Starfall crystal.

Kelp roots wrap Leviathan bone beside pieces of Sunken King's Festival
lanterns.

The Nexus has built a reef out of memories.
introTwitch:
Moonlit coral grows here.

So does Starfall crystal.

Kelp roots wrap Leviathan bone beside pieces of Sunken King's Festival
lanterns.

The Nexus has built a reef out of memories.

the-memory-reef-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across The Memory Reef.

left.message: Star Candies rest inside coral shaped exactly like Moonlit Reef.

right.message: A remembered Moonlit tide restores you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Memory Reef Warden forms from pieces of several regions.

the-memory-reef-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Memory Reef, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: The Warden shifts from coral to bone to starlight.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath a perfect recreation of Shizuki's first map.

She wrote:

'Look how bad it was.

...actually current maps not much better.'

forward.message: A cache contains festival ribbons, starstone and silver kelp.

the-memory-reef-threshold.prompt: Near Living Remembrance, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A coffer sits beneath a tiny Leviathan rib arch.

right.message: A Memory Reef Warden guards the deepest recollection.

forward.message: Memories of every previous rest stop overlap and restore you.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Living Remembrance
boss-antechamber.prompt: Living Remembrance assembles the journey into one enormous reef.

bossPromptDiscord:
Living Remembrance assembles the journey into one enormous reef.

At its center, something awakens from all five previous regions at once.

Use /yes to approach or /no to leave the scrapbook
monstrosity alone.
bossPromptTwitch:
Living Remembrance assembles the journey into one enormous reef.

At its center, something awakens from all five previous regions at once.

Use !yes to approach or !no to leave the scrapbook
monstrosity alone.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Living Remembrance. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The reef rises.

Archive-Reef Sovereign reveals itself!

completionText:
The Memory Reef settles.

Every region remains visible in miniature.

The journey is becoming something the Nexus remembers too.
